what: Plot Bayesian flood frequency curve with extended NVE-style uncertainty — fx.plot.quantile.curve.base
title: Plot Bayesian flood frequency curve with extended NVE-style uncertainty — fx.plot.quantile.curve.base
text: version expands lower-tail plotting-position uncertainty clamping probabilities \(p \le 0\) extremely small positive value (\(10^{-30}\)), allowing uncertainty bars extend much left, consistent NVE's Hydra/FlomQ implementation. Ascending ranks used uncertainty, lower-bound filtering applied resulting return periods. upper tail also clamped \(1 - \varepsilon\) avoid premature truncation.

text: Produces hydrology-style return-period plot (log-x) : scenario-specific posterior quantile curves, pointwise credible intervals, plotting-position uncertainty bars, observed annual maxima.

title: Plot Bayesian flood quantile curves with PP uncertainty and observations — fx.plot.quantile.curves.gg
code: fx.plot.quantile.curves.gg(   analyses,   labels = NULL,   color = NULL,   T.start = 1.01,   T.end = 1000,   plotting.formula = 0.44,   show.pp.uncertainty = TRUE,   eps = 1e-30 )

title: Plot Bayesian flood quantile curves with PP uncertainty and observations — fx.plot.quantile.curves.gg
text: analyses List analysis objects, one per scenario. element must contain least: ams: numeric vector annual maxima (extremes). .specific.discharge: logical; TRUE units specific discharge (l/km^2/s), FALSE discharge (m^3/s). additional components required quantile.summary(). labels Optional character vector scenario labels, length analyses. NULL, labels generated "Scenario 1", "Scenario 2", etc. color Optional character vector colors scenarios. T.start Numeric; minimum return period (years) used model curves (x-axis, log scale). Must strictly greater 1. T.end Numeric; maximum return period (years) used model curves (x-axis, log scale). plotting.formula Numeric; plotting-position constant \(\) used compute empirical return periods observed series, via $$p = ((n + 1 - ) - ) / (n + 1 - 2a), \quad T = 1 / (1 - p).$$ Defaults 0.44 (Gringorten). show.pp.uncertainty Logical; TRUE, plotting-position uncertainty shown horizontal segments observed value, based set alternative plotting-position constants. eps Numeric; small positive value used clamp plotting probabilities away 0 1 computing return periods uncertainty bars.

title: Plot Bayesian flood quantile curves with PP uncertainty and observations — fx.plot.quantile.curves.gg

text: file Filsti til Sildre/Hydra tidsseriefilen. sep Feltseparator filen (default ";"). ams.qdogn.txt Filsti lagring av AMS basert paa dognmiddel. ams.qmom.txt Filsti lagring av AMS basert paa dognmaksimum (kun hvis timesopplost input). plot Logical. Hvis TRUE, inkluderes ggplot_objekter returstrukturen. title Tittel paa plott/tabeller (default = "AMS SILDRE"). fontsize Skriftstorrelse tabell (default = 12). start_year NULL eller et tall som angir startaar (default = NULL, bruker forste aar data). end_year Tall som angir sluttaar (default = 2025, NULL bruker siste aar data).
